      • hasPermission

        public boolean hasPermission(String permission)
        Checks in this group and its's parent (and the parent of the parent etc etc) if it has permission and if the value is true. The first found "true" will be returned, false if there was no "true" or the node had false as value (ie. this group does not have this permission)
        Returns:
        true if has permission
